requests.text: Ask participants directly about which emotions they have felt during the different stages of this task to link subjective experience with analytical measures
requests.anchor: As discussed above, asking participants directly about which emotions they have felt during the different stages of this task would allow us to link subjective experience with our analytical measures.

requests.text: Test more participants to assess the impact of inter-individual variations in personality traits on the experience and neural correlates of guilt and responsibility
requests.anchor: Testing more participants would allow us to assess the impact of inter-individual variations in personality traits on the experience as well as the behavioural and neural correlates of guilt and responsibility.

requests.text: Use more trials to allow separate modelling of risk preferences in gain and loss trials in each condition and test whether happiness changes affect subsequent choices
requests.anchor: Using more trials in the experiment would allow separate modelling of risk preferences in gain and loss trials in each experimental condition using expected utility models, and could allow testing whether changes in momentary happiness affect subsequent choices.

requests.text: Vary partner identities (friends, stranger, artificial agent) to reveal the impact of social discounting on guilt and responsibility
requests.anchor: Varying partner identities (friends, stranger, artificial agent) could reveal the impact of social discounting on guilt and responsibility.

requests.text: Perform functional connectivity analyses for the data obtained in the feedback part of the paradigm
requests.anchor: Functional connectivity analyses could also be performed for the data obtained in the feedback part of the paradigm.
